market_question: Ukraine agrees not to join NATO before 2027?
reasoning: A neutral status or a time-limited pledge not to join NATO has been Russia's core demand and was discussed in 2022 peace talks. With military pressures and potential diplomatic shifts (e.g., a Trump presidency or EU-brokered ceasefire), it is plausible Ukraine will accept such a pledge as part of a formal or informal agreement by end-2026. The broad resolution criteria make a Yes more likely than the 19% current price implies.
evidence_points: Russia’s consistent demand for Ukrainian neutrality before any peace deal.
Historical precedent: Istanbul draft treaty (March 2022) included Ukraine agreeing not to join NATO in exchange for security guarantees.
Western fatigue and statements from potential future US administration indicating a push for a negotiated settlement including NATO restriction.
sources_consulted: Istanbul peace proposal reports (e.g., Financial Times, March 2022)
Expert analyses (e.g., CSIS, Chatham House) on war endgame scenarios
